# CLIGOO — Full Application Analysis

> Generated analysis of the CLIGOO halal food delivery platform — covering frontend, backend, dependencies, assets, third-party integrations, and project status.

---

## 1. What the app is

**CLIGOO** ("Click & Goo") is a **halal food delivery platform for France** — essentially an UberEats/Deliveroo clone scoped to halal-certified restaurants. It's a full-stack app **generated by the Emergent AI platform** (every git commit is an `emergent-agent-e1` auto-commit; the runtime is a prebuilt `fastapi_react_mongo_shadcn` Docker image).

**Four user types**, each with its own UI:
- **Customers** — browse, order, track delivery, video-call the courier
- **Couriers/drivers** — driver dashboard + recruitment landing
- **Restaurants** — restaurant dashboard + partner onboarding landing
- **Admins** — platform oversight dashboard

**Differentiators baked in:** halal certification badges everywhere (AVS, ARGML, Mosquée de Paris, SFCVH), bilingual **French/English** UI (~100+ i18n keys), and **in-app video calls** between customer and courier during delivery.

---

## 2. Architecture at a glance

```
React 19 SPA (CRA+craco, Tailwind, shadcn/ui)   ──axios──►   FastAPI (async)   ──Motor──►   MongoDB
        │                                                          │
   Daily.co video SDK ◄──────── room URLs/tokens ────────► Daily.co REST API
        │                                                          │
   Emergent OAuth redirect  ────── X-Session-ID ──────►  demobackend.emergentagent.com
```

- **Backend**: `server.py` mounts 4 routers, seeds the DB on startup, wildcard CORS. Async throughout (Motor + Uvicorn).
- **Frontend**: 12 routes, global state via React Context (`AppContext.jsx`), single axios client (`api.js`) that injects the JWT and sends cookies.
- **DB**: 7 collections, seeded with 8 restaurants + 10 categories on first boot.

---

## 3. Backend (FastAPI + MongoDB)

### Data model — 7 MongoDB collections
`users`, `user_sessions`, `restaurants`, `menus`, `categories`, `orders`, `video_calls`. Defined as Pydantic models in `backend/models.py`. Key shapes:
- **Order** carries a `stripe_split` sub-object (restaurant_payout / driver_payout / platform_fee) — modeled but **not connected to real Stripe** (test-mode fake account IDs like `acct_test_r1`).
- **Restaurant** is rich: cuisine tags, rating/reviews, delivery window/fee, min order, price level, halal `certification`, FR/EN descriptions.

### API surface (~20 endpoints)

| Router | Prefix | Endpoints |
|--------|--------|-----------|
| Auth | `/api/auth` | `register`, `login`, `google/session`, `me`, `logout` |
| Restaurants | `/api` | `restaurants` (filter/sort), `restaurants/{id}`, `restaurants/{id}/menu`, `categories` |
| Orders | `/api/orders` | `POST` create, `GET` list, `GET /{id}`, `PATCH /{id}/status` |
| Video | `/api/video-calls` | `create`, `end/{room}`, `status` |

### Money logic (`backend/routes/orders.py`)
- Service fee = **10%** of subtotal; platform commission = **30%** of subtotal (+ 100% of service fee).
- Restaurant gets subtotal minus commission; driver gets delivery fee + tip. All computed correctly and **test-verified** (e.g., subtotal 23.80 → total 30.67, split exact).

### Auth (`backend/auth_utils.py`)
Dual-provider: **JWT email/password** (bcrypt via passlib, HS256, 7-day expiry) **+ Emergent Google OAuth** (exchanges `X-Session-ID` → user, sets httpOnly cookie). `get_current_user` accepts either a session cookie or a Bearer token. A user who uses both becomes `auth_provider: "both"`.

### Seed data (`backend/seed_data.py`)
- **10 categories**: kebab, shawarma, burger, pizza, tajine, couscous, sushi, chicken, lebanese, dessert.
- **8 restaurants** (all Paris): Le Shawarma de Marrakech, Tajine & Co, Halal Smash House, Pizza Al Sultan, Sushi Halal Paris, Chicken Crunch Halal, Beirut Garden, Baklava Dreams.
- Custom menus for r1/r3/r4; default template for the rest. Categories inserted only if empty; restaurants/menus upserted (idempotent).

---

## 4. Frontend (React 19)

### 12 routes / pages (`frontend/src/pages/`)
Customer flow: **Landing → Restaurants → RestaurantDetail → Checkout → OrderTracking → Account**. Plus role surfaces: **RestaurantDashboard**, **DriverDashboard**, **AdminPanel**, two recruitment landings (**PartnerPage**, **DriverPage**), and **LoginPage**.

### Components
- **46 shadcn/ui primitives** in `frontend/src/components/ui/` (Radix-based).
- **7 custom components**: `Header`, `Footer`, `RestaurantCard`, `CartDrawer`, `VideoCallModal`, `AuthCallback`, `Logo`.

### State & data
`frontend/src/contexts/AppContext.jsx` holds **auth + cart + language + address**, all persisted to localStorage (`cligoo_token`, `cligoo_cart`, `cligoo_lang`, `cligoo_address`). The cart enforces single-restaurant ordering. The `frontend/src/lib/api.js` axios client uses `withCredentials` (for the OAuth cookie) and a Bearer interceptor.

### Build tooling
craco overrides CRA to add Tailwind, the `@/*` path alias, a custom **webpack health-check plugin** (`frontend/plugins/health-check/`), and **`@emergentbase/visual-edits`** — Emergent's tooling that lets non-engineers edit React components visually in dev.

---

## 5. Third-party APIs & integrations

| Integration | Where | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **Daily.co** (WebRTC video) | `backend/routes/video.py` + `VideoCallModal.jsx` | ✅ Working, with a **dev-mode fallback** when `DAILY_API_KEY` is absent (returns demo room URLs) |
| **Emergent OAuth** (Google sign-in) | auth router + AuthCallback | ✅ Working, hits `demobackend.emergentagent.com` |
| **Stripe Connect** | Order `stripe_split` model + Checkout UI | ⚠️ **Mocked** — split math only, no real charges |
| **PostHog** analytics | `frontend/public/index.html` | Embedded |
| **AWS / boto3** | requirements only | ❌ Listed, never used |
| **Emergent visual-edits** | craco config | Dev tooling |

---

## 6. Assets & images

- **Only one local image asset**: `public/cligoo-logo.png` (the brand logo, used in `Logo.jsx`). A recent commit converted it from `.jpeg` → `.png`.
- **Everything else is remote** — all restaurant photos, category tiles, hero images, and food imagery are **Unsplash/Pexels URLs** (sized with `?w=800&q=80`), both in the backend seed data and the frontend mock file. No bundled food images, no S3 uploads.
- Maps in OrderTracking/DriverDashboard are **SVG mockups**, not real geolocation.

---

## 7. Dependency inventory

### Backend (Python — `backend/requirements.txt`)
- **Core**: fastapi, uvicorn, motor, pymongo, pydantic, python-dotenv
- **Auth/security**: pyjwt, bcrypt, passlib, cryptography, email-validator
- **HTTP/integrations**: httpx (used by video + OAuth), requests, requests-oauthlib
- **Listed but unused in code**: `boto3`, `pandas`, `numpy`, `python-jose`, `jq`, `typer`
- **Custom/proprietary**: `emergentintegrations==0.1.0` (not on PyPI; never imported)
- **Dev/test**: pytest, black, isort, flake8, mypy

### Frontend (JS — `frontend/package.json`)
- **Framework**: react 19, react-dom 19, react-router-dom 7
- **UI**: 28 `@radix-ui/*` packages, shadcn/ui, lucide-react (icons), embla-carousel, vaul, cmdk, sonner (toasts), recharts (charts)
- **Forms**: react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, zod
- **State/data**: jotai, axios, date-fns
- **Styling**: tailwindcss, tailwind-merge, tailwindcss-animate, class-variance-authority, clsx
- **Video**: @daily-co/daily-js, @daily-co/daily-react
- **Build**: react-scripts (CRA), @craco/craco, postcss, autoprefixer
- **Emergent**: `@emergentbase/visual-edits` (dev dependency from assets.emergent.sh)

---

## 9. Notable gaps & risks

- **Security**: `JWT_SECRET` defaults to `'change-me'` if unset; CORS is wildcard with credentials; JWT stored in localStorage (XSS-exposed); no rate limiting; **no authorization on order status updates** (any authenticated user can move any order).
- **No real roles** — backend treats everyone as a customer; courier is hardcoded as "Karim".
- **Dashboards are facades** — admin/driver/restaurant screens read mock data, not the API.
- **Payments are simulated** — the whole Stripe split is test-mode numbers.
- **Unused dependencies** — `boto3`, `pandas`, `numpy`, `python-jose`, `requests-oauthlib`, `jq` are in requirements but never imported.

---

## 10. Bottom line

CLIGOO is a **polished, AI-generated halal-food-delivery MVP**. The **customer-facing path is genuinely end-to-end functional** (browse → order → track → video-call), backed by a clean, tested FastAPI/Mongo API. What's left to make it real: wire the three role dashboards to the backend, add role-based authorization, and replace the mocked Stripe split with actual Stripe Connect.

---

## Appendix — Local setup notes

To run on localhost (Windows):
- **Prereqs installed**: Python 3.12, MongoDB Community 8.3 (Windows service on `:27017`), Yarn 1.22.
- **Env files**: `backend/.env` (`MONGO_URL`, `DB_NAME=cligoo`), `frontend/.env` (`REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8000`).
- **Backend deps**: installed from `backend/requirements.local.txt` (drops unused `emergentintegrations` + `jq`, adds `httpx`).
- **Run**: backend `uvicorn server:app --port 8000`; frontend `yarn start` (port 3000).
